hypothesis: Do three originally selected independent DOI source studies of the same mule deer species maintain an apparent q~astronomical daylength association after daily regional Tmax and preceding 30-day P-ET0 are included? If environmental adjustment reduces the signal differently, which direction and which source is robust?
original_source_selection: Exactly all three Odocoileus hemionus entries in the SHA-frozen five-source manifest, no replacement or selection after new daily weather outcome.
weather_cell_definition: For each original GPS-qualified source tag/day, modelled 1 degree cell floor(lat),floor(lon), cell center +0.5. No interpolation. Query all source q-eligible cell/year months full range and prior 29 days; no favorable climate-date/grid selection.
weather_data_sanity: daily field units exact °C,°C,mm,mm; missing allowed as source-weather HOLD; complete 30 daily calendar days preceding and including original q date before calculating P-ET0; avoid future climate. Require zero weather grid errors for FULL_SOURCE_WEATHER_COVERAGE, otherwise label partial descriptive or HOLD.
q_observation: same exact prior UTC-hour selected original GPS and original one_taxon n/mean, 0.5-2 h q-qualified nighttime/daytime individual solar-day; per original individual year >=10 days with at least .5h local astronomical daylength range, no time or position interpolation.
estimation: Reuse exact existing adjusted_daily_effects and partial_slope old Wyoming code with >=10/15 original days, >=0.5h L range and residual variance checks, equal years per tagged animal and equal animal weight; nominal 2000 original-animal bootstrap 95 intervals, source DOI is one study. Strong inferential claims require common sample across source and weather axes, not automatically given by different source-qualified cohorts.
evidence_update_rule: Old Wyoming source DOI 1.703 day-level climate result is historical descriptive context, not a numeric replay target if provider weather physical version changed. All original GPS first q/daylength n and means must replay exactly before new weather retrieval. Do not reclassify 12 previous raw-JSON ERA5 SHA HOLDs or 48-source external sunlight/heading nonreplication.
weather_provenance_new_version: Fresh provider weather response in new analysis does NOT establish equivalence to historic old ERA5 raw/physical arrays; record source-level ordered daily SHA256 fingerprint and grid hold counts only, never actual GPS coordinates, grid IDs, individual weather joined data or exact dates.
scientific_limits: Target species and three DOIs selected AFTER inspecting old q/month slopes, not prospective test. Weather data at 1deg is coarse environmental context; no direct body heat, plant phenology or forage biomass, no causality. Distinct source DOIs not verified disjoint tagged populations (two Wyoming cohorts could overlap). Solar daylength and yearly heat/precipitation are coupled, and sources have different GPS schedules.
